name: order-management
description: Multi-tenant order management backend — a step-by-step learning project

scripts.test:contract: pnpm contract:down && docker compose -p oms-contract -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.contract.yml --profile app run --build --rm schemathesis
scripts.contract:down: docker compose -p oms-contract -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.contract.yml --profile app down -v
scripts.db:explain: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U oms -d oms -f - < services/api/prisma/explain/lists.sql
scripts.db:explain:partitions: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U oms -d oms -f - < services/api/prisma/explain/partitions.sql
scripts.db:explain:rls: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U oms -d oms -f - < services/api/prisma/explain/rls.sql
